engine: latest supplied Avalisa signalEngine.js and indicators.js, source-exact defaults, no rule tuning or trained model
timing: confirmed candle close, next observed base-bar open. This is a changed timing candidate, not original tick-exact operation; no forming-candle final data used early
source_short: existing complete5s PO export and public October1-7/November1-17 samples, previously viewed, descriptive only; no pristine short holdout claimed
source_long: SHA256-verified Binance public monthly1m archives BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT/SOLUSDT January2025-October2026. Complete UTC-aligned resampling, no gaps fabricated. Publiccrypto proxy, not OTC/exchange contract fills
holdout_limits: Chronological separation for this fixed grid; coarser price histories from these dates were used in earlier research, so confirmation is not pristine independent evidence or prospective performance.
warmup: source low12/mid16/high20 indicator bars, buffer50, reset on gaps; do not loosen filters to force long-timeframe trades
fills: flat1unit per trade; ties refund; no per-asset overlap; exact expiry observed open; no split crossing; source interval5s for short,60s for long. Stress delays entry one source bar (5s or60s); cannot claim5s latency from1m OHLC
selection: at most one global configuration from long validation, at least200 decided trades,30UTCdays,Wilson lower>90% payout breakeven,one-sided binomial p<.05/168,positive lower day-cluster bootstrap mean90,>=2 profitable assets,positive latency stress90; rank Wilson lower then config ID. No reselection after confirmation.
confirmation: report all frozen grid configurations transparently, but only preselected candidate can qualify. Require >=200 decided,>=15UTCdays,Wilson lower>90% breakeven,positive lower day-bootstrap mean90,>=2 profitableassets,positive delayed90. Sparse modes are insufficient evidence, not automatically losing.
scope: all standard listed timeframes, not literally every possible duration; daily can be sparse with22months. No extension deployment, real orders, account access, martingale, favorite rotation or shared-account equity claim.
